Knock Off: The Battle for Imagination

Fight for the fate of imagination in this fast-paced 2D fighter inspired by classic arcade games and 80s/90s action figures. Master air combos, EX moves, assists, and super attacks with a roster of wild off-brand toy legends.

Set thousands of years in the future, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet puts players into the role of Jordan A. Mun, a dangerous bounty hunter who ends up stranded on Sempiria – a distant planet whose communication with the outside universe went dark hundreds of years ago. Jordan will have to use all her skills and wits if she hopes to be the first person in over 600 years to leave its orbit.

Experience a unique game mechanic where when lining up jumps time slows down to help navigate tricky sections and dodge dangerous obstacles.

Enjoy a beautiful immersive world brought alive through high-quality unique 2D art. Enjoy the dynamic day night cycle, unique lighting effects, and varied environmental & weather systems that help make the world as engaging, stunning, and immersive as possible.

Buy today and start Leena's adventure!

There are currently 10 levels, I plan to increase this over time. Please bear with me.

Jump, dodge, and soar your way to victory in JumpJumpJump! Take control of a fearless girl as she leaps from platform to platform, avoiding dangerous obstacles and moving hazards to reach the finish line. Precision and timing are key—one wrong move, and it’s game over!
Build a tower by dropping blocks one by one! Aim accurately and stack the blocks squarely on each other and form the tallest skyscraper!

Golden Racing is a fast-paced arcade racing game where speed and precision are the keys to victory. Take control of powerful sports cars and race through thrilling tracks filled with sharp turns and challenging obstacles, with one goal in mind: reach the finish line before time runs out. Every second counts in this adrenaline-fueled challenge, where only the most skilled drivers can claim the glory and become champions of Golden Racing.

You are a pig on the run, and someone is hunting you down! Dash, sneak, and use the environment to your advantage to avoid capture. Navigate through forests, fields, and villages, find hiding spots, and overcome obstacles with clever tactics. Every choice matters—will you escape to freedom or end up in your pursuer’s grasp?
The doctor's simulator. You will have to treat patients from various diseases. For each successfully cured patient, you receive funding. Improve your hospital, treat new diseases, diagnose symptoms.

SCHIZOPHRENIA. A psychological horror game, which will immerse you in a dark, sad, environment. This bastard is knocking, wake up, and open the door now. First game of TheCourget. Created by TheCourget

Dive into a psychological thriller filled with adventure and puzzles, with touches of horror. Join Detective Bennett on his final case and unravel dark secrets in a world where reality twists and sanity crumbles.
Taram Baba is an Action Roguelike with spectacular combat. Plunge your light deeper and deeper into the darkness of the abyss and fight your way to Taram Baba.
Shoot the wall! Simple, right? Use your gun to blast your way through the wall, upgrade and change your weapons so you can shoot your way through the wall even faster!

You are entrusted with training five "troubled" influencers from Mountain & Sea Media, and gain the “Heart Probe” ability which allows you to uncover girls’ inner thoughts. Use your wisdom and ability to help them meet their training KPIs, while discovering their real selves beneath their facades.

Soar Through Serenity. Take flight in a world made of calm and curiosity.

Paper Plane is a peaceful journey through a hand-crafted papercraft world. Glide effortlessly on the breeze, discover hidden wonders, and collect shimmering moments of joy. With no time limits, enemies, or stress, it’s a relaxing experience for players of all ages — whether you’re chasing sunlight through autumn leaves or simply drifting above the rooftops.
Rediscover the quiet joy of exploration, one gentle glide at a time.

Fly free. Wander far. Wonder always.

Introducing Blades of Fire, an all-new action adventure that takes you across a beautiful world full of uncertainty and challenge. You take on the role of Aran de Lira, firstborn of the King’s Ward. The newly crowned Queen Nerea has cast a powerful spell that turns steel into stone and only her arms of abominations wield the divine metal against which other blades shatter…

Avatarland is a jigsaw puzzle game with a twist. Solve puzzles to unlock new levels, then discover and collect your favorite avatars from the in-game store. Join the weekly challenge, race to complete puzzles faster than players around the world, and climb the global leaderboard. With fresh puzzles and avatars added regularly, there's always a reason to Piece Out!

Dustwind: Resistance is a single-player tactical game. Lead your squad—including your dog—against a brutal raider army. Pause to plan tactics. Use brutal firepower, stealth, traps, turrets, or an armored car to outmaneuver enemies. Protect your home and freedom. No surrender!

Experience the most surreal shooter ever made. LSD Battlefield Simulator, the mythical 12th installment in the #1 best-selling FPS franchise Tour of Honor, is finally here—remastered and unleashed after 25 years in the vault.

Wildgate is a PVP multiplayer shooter that blends tactical ship-to-ship combat with fast-paced first-person action. Evade deadly environmental hazards, search for powerful weapons and ship upgrades, and be the first crew to escape with the Artifact... or the last crew left flying.
Face endless waves of enemies in this action roguelike! Choose a hero, enhance your stats with Modifiers, and unlock powerful Augments. Can you survive for 15 minutes?

Too long in this prison, time to get out of here. Pull the carpet and start digging with a teaspoon. Watch out for the guard, sell him the junk you find. Trade toilet paper with the prisoners. Get better items and improve your stats. Expand the tunnel, use glow sticks and dynamite. Will you escape?

VOID/BREAKER is an Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS. Fight relentless machines driven by a hostile AI. Escape an endless cycle. Craft infinite weapon variants with deep gun modding. Forge deadly synergies. Carve your way out through environmental destruction/BREAK THE SYSTEM /BREAK THE SEQUENCE /BREAK FREE

Jump, dodge, and fight to the rhythm of the gods in this thrilling music-action game on skis. Take on obstacles and menacing enemies as you ski further into the darkness that has befallen the snow-covered land of Norwyn.

Face unpredictable dangers, fight perilous fires with your crew, and save lives in Firefighting Simulator: Ignite. Step into the boots of a U.S. firefighter and play with up to 3 friends or with the help of your NPC controlled crew members.
The Trolley Solution is a compilation of point-and-click minigames based on the famous thought experiment originally proposed by Philippa Foot.

Liminal cosmic horror - you'll wander in an abandoned amusement park, walk along empty tunnels and crawl through narrow corridors. Join a ride and step into the dark. Explore eerie remains of a world that shouldn't exist. Find clues and discover the truth, but beware, some things should stay buried.

The Light of Celestia is a story-driven action-adventure featuring intense combat and mystical exploration. Step into the role of Zoe, a destined protector bound to ancient magic, as she unravels the secrets of Eldoria. Confront dark forces, uncover lost truths, and embrace the light within.

The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

A narrative simulation game where you play as a mother-to-be working as a toll keeper in the fictional country of Janapa, a nation on the brink of chaos. Navigate daily challenges and make difficult moral choices to survive—all for the sake of your unborn child.

Blast. Collect. Upgrade. Repeat. Void Miner is a retro-inspired roguelite asteroid shooter where you pilot a space ship and manage an automated tower to destroy endless fields of chaos. Dodge, blast, and harvest your way through waves of asteroids in a fast-paced loop of destruction and progression.

A 2D hand-painted cat platformer blending gentle puzzles with heartfelt boss encounters. Play as Princess, a flat-faced cat. Use purr — her softest gift, to heal a world caught between nature and machine.
All the passion, beauty & intensity of pro motorsport merging the most iconic cars & circuits with a new benchmark in handling performance.

Put your forensic skills to the test in this brand new first person survival horror, She's Leaving. Play as Charles Dalton, a blood spatter analyst tasked with the most gruesome crime scene of his life. Can you survive a night in House Haywood?

Stranded in the desert, your only hope of escaping rests in a strange Catman. His one request: hunt down surreal creatures, skin them, and chop them up so he can keep them as trophies. In this uncanny place, Death will become all too familiar.

Dive into the ultimate moving experience in Moving Simulator! Manage chaotic house moves, carefully pack belongings, load trucks, and navigate through hilarious disasters. Precision, speed, and creativity will make you a moving master!

The Wellmonts Case is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1993, Northern Maine. As a private detective, you explore the abandoned Wellmont farm, search for clues, photograph unsettling evidence, and uncover the truth behind a family's unexplained disappearance.
A brand new entry into the legendary Bitmap Brothers series! Venture into the grim future of 2138 where mega-corporations use Speedball to distract the downtrodden masses from their miserable lives.

Latest ultra-violent sci-fi action title from Grasshopper Manufacture and Suda51.

Step into the blood-soaked boots of Romeo Stargazer, a man pulled back from the brink of death by a time paradox gone wrong. Now reborn as Agent Dead Man of the FBI Space-Time Division, and armed with the mysterious Dead Gear mask, Romeo must chase the universe’s most dangerous fugitives across alternate realities.

Blending high-octane gunplay, brutal sword combat, and over-the-top sci-fi insanity, Romeo Is a Dead Man is GhM’s bloodiest action game yet. Players can expect mind-bending twists, outrageous gimmicks, and a deeply cathartic combat system that turns enemies’ powers against them in universe-shattering battles.

As Romeo tears through the multiverse, he’s also on a desperate quest to find Juliet, his mysteriously vanished girlfriend. With a narrative that fuses love, loss, and metaphysical chaos, Romeo Is a Dead Man offers a stylish and unpredictable journey through the very fabric of time itself.

Can you survive the bleeding edge of space-time? Or will you become just another ghost in the paradox?

Norse is a turn-based tactics and combat game for PC and console. Set against the rich backdrop of the Viking Age, join Gunnar, a young warrior, on a relentless quest for revenge across the rugged landscapes of Norway.

Build a thriving settlement, govern your community, forge alliances, grow strong, and win the favour of the gods. For this is a time when legends are forged in the fires of conflict, and only the brave are remembered.

Written by prize-winning and Sunday Times bestselling author Giles Kristian, Norse is set in a fully realised historical world, driven by a compelling narrative and brimming with memorable characters.

Aerial_Knight’s Dropshot is a high-speed, stylized FPS / Race where you play as Smoke Wallace. As a kid, he was bitten by a radioactive dragon, turning his skin purple and giving him the power to fire bullets from his fingertips. Thrown into deadly sky battles for revenge, you race rivals, fight dragons, move fast, shoot smart, and look cool when you land.

Run a shop in the zombie apocalypse! Trade batteries, craft stock, manage your staff, and fend off undead hordes. Will you be a hero, or profit at any cost? Your choices shape your store - and your fate.

Step into the shoes of a golf architect as you build and manage your own golfing paradise! Sharpen your strategy by designing incredible courses to challenge the most demanding golfers and watch your club flourish as you attract VIP players, hire quirky staff and hold prestigious tournaments.

A mining station in the Pacific abyss is no longer responding. As an investigator of the occult, unravel the mysteries of the deep. Test your wits and sanity in this thriller inspired by the master of Providence.

Causal Loop is a narrative puzzler that blends mind-bending mechanics with a rich sci-fi story about time, consequence, and survival. Solve intricate puzzles by using the unique “echo” mechanic to record, replay, and interact with up to three versions of your past self. Can you break the loop?

In up to four player co-op, form a group of explorers searching for treasure. In this cursed jungle, danger is everywhere and monstrous creatures alter reality. Stay clear-headed and tame the jungle before it devours you…

The ultimate multiplayer open world designed by Pro riders. Discover mountains and trails with limitless control and build your own career. Pull huge tricks or race through the global rankings! Nail challenges to secure sponsorship deals with real world brands. Are you ready?

Wild Blue Skies reimagines the classic on-rail adventures of the '90s. Join Bowie Stray and the Blue Bombers as they soar through the skies on a mission to save the world in this action-packed, nostalgic journey!

Embark on the ultimate maritime experience with Seafarer: The Ship Sim. Choose between careers, take the helm of a variety of ships, and expand your fleet. Navigate a vast open world and become immersed in the beautiful expanses and rolling waves.

Repair your rundown RV and hit the road in a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can. Every journey offers a unique experience!

Step into the paws of a loyal shepherd dog in this atmospheric third-person adventure. Track scents, herd sheep, and navigate the rugged northern wilderness. Face rough weather, natural predators and not so obedient sheeps.

It's 1977. Henry Gray awakens in a psychiatric hospital, haunted by the ghosts of his past. Fire and Ashes await: An immersive survival horror where nothing is certain, insanity and reality mix, and voice recognition means every monster will hear you scream - within the asylum and beyond…

A ragtag squad of robot rejects is hired by the SAXON corporation and given one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). They are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.

Breach Signal is a 1-6 Player Co-op Psychological Horror game. Enter a special unit operating for The Agency, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

The Shadow Syndicate is a stylized noir stealth-action game set in 1930s Brooklyn. Sneak, fight, and uncover a dark conspiracy using supernatural powers. Explore a vibrant city, play mini-games, and solve mysteries in this thrilling cinematic experience.
Ultima Chess VR – chess as you've never seen before! Battle on the chessboard in virtual reality, where every piece comes to life and engages in a fantasy duel!

Never's End is a turn-based tactical RPG where you return from death into the midst of a global cataclysm. Possess townsfolk to use them as living weapons, wield the forces of nature to reshape the battlefield, and lead mankind back from the brink of extinction.

Sea of Remnants is an original ocean adventure RPG developed by Joker Studio. Your journey begins as a puppetfolk sailor who has lost their memory. Alongside a mysterious girl, you’ll set sail on a chaotic and colorful voyage—one filled with treasure, conflict, dreams, and unexpected companions. As the seas stretch endlessly before you, an epic world of myth and history slowly unfolds. But beware, Captain: fall overboard, and your mind may be swallowed by the very thing this ocean was named for—forgetting.

Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.
The Most Realistic Sprinting Game to date! • The right balance between arcade like fun and real-world sprinting simulation. • How Fast Can You Go?
A shark. A wall. A dodge. A meme. Swipe, switch, and laugh as the viral "Tralalero Tralala" sound follows your every move. No pressure. Just pure meme-powered chaos.

Step into the boots of an elite tactical freelancer in this ultra-realistic first-person shooter that delivers the raw, unfiltered intensity of real police operations. Through authentic bodycam perspective, experience heart-pounding counter-terrorism missions where split-second decisions mean the difference between life and death.

Designed for the power of PlayStation 5 consoles, and enhanced for PS VR2, this free, immersive experience puts you in the middle of Earth’s most critical story: our own.

Over 90 minutes of interactive content - narrated by climate advocate Laura Tobin - takes you through rising seas, shifting temperatures, and stark climate futures, all built from real-world data by NASA, NOAA, and the IPCC.

Explore three main zones: Weather Year (a time-lapse of planetary change), Observations (where we are), and Projections (where we could go).
Medieval Escape is a third-person adventure game. The protagonist is a young woman trapped in an ancient medieval labyrinth. To survive, she must avoid deadly traps and find a way out.

Connect the roads and build a thriving city in this engaging puzzle game. With 40 challenging levels, a dynamic soundtrack, and sleek low-poly visuals, each puzzle you solve brings streets to life, sparking new homes and bustling traffic. Dive into a satisfying and strategic experience as you piece together the perfect path to grow your urban world.

Defend a NYC subway train from relentless alien waves as a lone security guard. Scavenge scarce ammo, upgrade your pistol with attachments and sub-weapons, fortify chokepoints, and survive increasingly deadly assaults in this tactical wave-based shooter.

Trial of Greed is a minimalist first-person dungeon crawler where your only path forward is guided by one thing: gold. In a vast, procedurally generated level filled with mysterious locked doors and hidden chests, your mission is simple—collect enough gold to buy your way through.

Fire up your engines and hit the tracks in Lawn Mower Racing, the ultimate competitive racing game with a humorous twist! Whether you're racing SOLO or in the exciting SPLIT-SCREEN MODE, you'll experience a unique blend of fun and strategy.
Treasure Tiger is a first-person horror game where every spin brings you closer to fortune… or to something far worse.

Nengchi, can you hold yourself? On the cusp of immortality, the prodigy from Sect of Pure Retreat is forced to face his trail in "Eden of Yao"- a realm of seductive spirits. As the temptresses unleash their charms, can you hold your Chan mind?

Classic Solitaire brings the beloved card game you know and love into a sleek, beautifully designed experience—perfect for quick play sessions or long, relaxing streaks. Whether you're a veteran card shark or just learning the ropes, this version offers something for everyone.

Mergery is a puzzle game where each move combines images into higher-ranked visuals. Start with the basics and merge your way toward rare and powerful artwork. Every decision matters as you manage space, plan your moves, and push for the perfect merge.
Second Coat is a fast-paced multiplayer paintball game where players compete against each other by using strategy and skill to outmaneuver opponents, rack up eliminations, and achieve victory.

This vertical platformer challenges your reflexes, timing, and precision across 40 adventure levels and an endless arcade mode with over 1 billion unique combinations.

Collect coins as you ascend, and try to beat the gold time on each level. Collecting every coin and finishing under the gold time awards gold stars. It’s all about precision, speed, and finding the best path upward.

As you progress, you'll travel through a variety of environments and experience shifting times of day, including bright middays, glowing sunsets, and quiet midnight climbs. Each level encourages players to push their skills further.

Compete with friends and players around the world on global leaderboards. Every adventure level tracks your best time — can you claim the top spot?

Whether you're collecting every coin or racing for the best time, Zip’s Jumping Adventures delivers a focused, skill-based challenge with plenty of variety!

Nachtmahr is a third-person adventure where you play as a magical unicorn, exploring five realms filled with puzzles, collectibles, and secrets. Uncover a poetic story as you journey through a world of wonder and magic.

Anchor Light is a first-person anomaly-hunting experience set within a lavish, mysterious lighthouse. In this unique game, light and shadow are your tools and your enemies. You'll need to observe every detail, as each room holds secrets waiting to be uncovered.

A wide spectrum of anomalies will test your perception and sanity. From subtle distortions that question your memory to deeply unsettling scenes, every moment is designed to linger, striking a balance between dread and awe. The finely-tuned gameplay ensures that each run feels fresh and compelling.

Key Features
Tense 'Red Light, Green Light' Mechanic: The music is your guide. When it stops, so should you. Any movement during a music cut can be your last, so freeze, listen, and pray that whatever is hunting you doesn't find you.

Floppy Disk Collectibles: Discover floppy disks scattered throughout the lighthouse to reveal fragments of the past. These memories from previous inhabitants offer crucial clues to the horrors you're facing.

Unlockable Difficulty Modes: Master the game in Normal and Hard modes, then face the ultimate challenge in Nightmare mode, where familiar layouts are twisted into new terrors.

Leaderboards and Endless Mode: Immortalize your fastest times on the leaderboards across all difficulty modes, or test your endurance in Endless mode to see how many floors you can clear without getting caught.

ScootX is the ultimate scooter sim with satisfying physics and endless spots to ride. Hop on, drop in, and send it. The first scooter game where everything, from the wheels to the rider’s head, is powered by physics. Every grind, whip, and slam reacts the way it should.

Step into the chaotic rhythm of DOOMCRUSH, a visually striking arcade experience where every tap is a fight for survival. This high-intensity game blends fast reflexes with a meta-narrative twist, as you battle against time, destruction, and the game’s own rebellious antagonist, Dystro—who wants nothing more than to erase himself from existence.

A dark, 2.5D, 100% physics-based motorcycle platformer where you wake up locked in a shipping container and must ride through deadly obstacle courses to escape. Inspired by Squid Game, Limbo, and Trials, MotoTrials seamlessly blends storytelling and challenging gameplay.

From Lee Petty and Double Fine Productions, Keeper is an atmospheric puzzle adventure in which a long-forgotten lighthouse is awakened and, joined by a spirited seabird, it embarks upon a heartening tale of unlikely companionship, and an unexpected journey into realms beyond understanding.

In the year 2089, the United Federation of Japan is an industrial powerhouse, while also being one of the world’s leading countries in overtime work.

In this sickening future, the economy is booming and working 24 hours a day is considered virtuous.

The core of this country’s industry, economy, and social system are controlled by a single giant corporation.

The rampage of a fully mechanized schoolgirl—a fully armed cyborg heroine storms into a giant corporation and unleashes a relentless barrage of gunfire and sword action in this exhilarating cyborg schoolgirl action adventure. The feeling of immorality is irresistible when you break into an office and wreak havoc.

Absorb enemy powers and turn them against their masters in this frenetic, up to 4 player co-op hack’n’slash. Cancel actions for total control, chain devastating abilities, and take down brutal bosses across eclectic biomes. Sharpen your build with every thrilling run.

Blow your leaves and your cares away in this chilled out work sim. Build up your business, buy new tools, and unlock upgrades - all while watching the leaves fly. After all, one man’s trash is another man’s cash.

The Solo Leveling webtoon is now an action RPG!
Live the epic journey of E-Rank hunter Sung Jinwoo on his way to becoming the Monarch of Shadows!

Beach Invasion 1915: Gallipoli is a first-person shooter set during the WWI Gallipoli campaign where players defend fortified coastlines against allied forces. Players use period-accurate weapons and defensive tactics, including mines and explosives, to repel waves of infantry, armored vehicles, aircraft, and naval vessels attempting to breach their position.
Drive real military vehicles, deliver critical cargo, and master first-person logistics solo or with friends. Rescue survivors, provide infrastructure, and rebuild a war-torn region!

Isekai: I'm an FPS Hero Who Was Summoned to Another World

I'm a die-hard FPS gamer. By mistake, I became the hero of an Isekai story. An incompetent Goddess summoned me to her world to defeat the Demon Lord. I'm in my element—guns, upgrades, action, and hordes of monsters to slay. There's even some magic… and Goddesses…
Run, run, run as fast as you can, you can’t escape the Cheese Man!
Shmup Roguelite – Dodge Hell, Power Up, Repeat, Conquer Netunia’s Sky with Captain Puff MacFly!

Return home to Port Wake and rebuild your family business. Docked is a realistic simulator where you operate heavy machinery, restore and develop the port's infrastructure, and manage day-to-day operations to help your port expand and thrive.

Build your weapon to its full potential in Galactic Vault, a fast-paced FPS roguelite. Discover endless upgrade combinations, craft diverse builds, and unleash devastating abilities. Get ready to infiltrate high-security vaults and recover lost tech.

Journey through a tumultuous Medieval Italy as Aeta, a young knight errant who sets off on a brutal quest to find and save her closest one. 1348 Ex Voto is a cinematic action-adventure game inspired by chivalric tales.

Grind Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike where demon hunters face endless hellspawn. Dodge, loot, and blast through brutal bullet-hell combat with dynamic builds and ever-changing weapons in a scorched, demon-ridden world.

A coin-pushing dopamine machine. RACCOIN is a roguelike deckbuilder where you combine special coins with powerful items to trigger wildly satisfying combos. Stack shiny towers, spin the lucky wheel, and shake the machine until all the coins drop.

Hide your flag. Find the enemy flag. Run it back, then defend for a minute to win it. Welcome to Last Flag: a fast-paced 5v5 shooter with showstopping contestants, set in a televised competition where strategy, teamwork, and chaos blend in the ultimate game of Capture the Flag.

Dive into a world of wonder!
A dazzling monster-taming Action RPG!

Stranded on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This action-packed sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay.

Cubic Cosmos is a roguelike deckbuilder which combines fast-paced card battles with unique tower-defense gameplay. Build up your deck, construct your strategy, unlock heroes, and encounter random events. Forge your unique path ahead with every step you take!

Step into the driver’s seat in Bus Bound, the latest title from the creators of Bus Simulator 21. Explore the vibrant city of Emberville in officially licensed buses, and help transform it into a pedestrian-friendly paradise—one stop at a time.

Play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn how to use his nose to reunite with his family after a forest fire. Explore beautiful landscapes, track scents, and uncover secrets as you slowly reconnect with nature in this cozy animal adventure.

The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales

The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales is an action RPG set in the world of Philabieldia - a beautiful but savage land dominated by warring beast tribes. Humanity’s last bastion is the Kingdom of Huther, protected by its tall walls and Princess Heuria’s powerful magic.

When a mysterious set of ruins is discovered, a young adventurer named Elliot and his fairy companion Faie are sent off on a journey to investigate. What seems like a simple, if dangerous, mission soon becomes a grand saga that will be woven across time and space.

Flip, trick and grind your train in a fast-paced, off-the-rails ride through a colourful Japanese dystopia. Outmatch rival gangs, wreck a shady megacorp, and take back the tracks with nothing but skill, speed, and style.

Fading Echo is a fast-paced elemental action-adventure RPG where creativity fuels combat. Manipulate water, trigger chain reactions, and shift through surreal worlds as One, a young Legend on a mission to save a dying desertscape from the grip of the Paradox corruption.

Build and run your own waterpark. Design slides, send guests flying with ragdoll physics, manage staff, and fully customize your park. Turn total madness into a diamond five-star empire in this first-person management simulator!

Space Tail is a 2.5D adventure platformer that follows an emotional, story-driven journey through the cosmos. Play as a brave space-traveling dog exploring mysterious planets, solving puzzles, and forming unique bonds with alien civilizations along the way.

In post-apocalyptic Japan, humanity’s last hope may rest with Emma and her loyal canine companion, Koo. Explore what it means to be human in Beast of Reincarnation, an expansive one-person, one-dog action RPG built around demanding, technical combat. What awaits at journey’s end?

Catch Flex is a full-body dance rhythm game played in front of a single camera, with no VR headset, no gamepad and no wearables. The camera sees your whole body, your moves are the input, and even the menus are gesture-controlled. Tracking runs locally on the device, or on a phone running the free Catch Flex: Controller app, which sends only movement data over the local network and never uploads video.

Six kinds of move make up a chart. Slash blocks in the direction of the arrow, catch rings with a hand or a foot, kick the balls or knock them back, stomp floor markers on the beat, ride slide trails to the end, and dodge obstacles by ducking, leaning or stepping over. Vol. 1 holds ten hand-charted original tracks from 96 to 150 BPM, house, electro and techno, all charted within reach of a real body with no jumping needed. An optional no-fail mode lets you move through a whole song without chasing a score.

Beyond the solo run there is local split-screen Versus for two players, global leaderboards and ten achievements. Custom levels are made in Catch Flex Editor, a free browser editor, and loaded into the game over Wi-Fi. The game also reads charts saved in other common level formats.

HELLBOUND INC is a hellish 2D platformer where you jump & carry packages to deliver against time, demons and HR. Play as an undead courier trapped in a fulfillment center recently purchased by Satan himself.
Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s and you have three months left at school. So REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school!

Team up with your friends and build a thriving trade empire in this CO-OP strategy and economy simulation set on a lively island. Begin with a small market, share tasks, manage production chains, raise livestock, and dominate the economy together through changing seasons and dynamic festivals!

Aniimo is a free-to-play, next-gen creature-catching open-world RPG. Explore the vast continent of Idyll, Twine with unique Aniimo, unlock new abilities. Travel to a sky-floating metropolis, meet other Pathfinders, and battle in exciting competitions. Choose your Aniimo and begin your epic journey!

A stylized third-person spy action game with infiltration, gunplay, Close Quarter Combat (CQC) and innovative and dynamic sabotage gadget crafting with brand new science-fiction based stealth action multiplayer gameplay!
Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility's derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them.

Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories.

Beat the Devil at his own game. The Killing Stone is a deckbuilding card battler wrapped in a 17th century folk horror narrative. Clean the sins of a cursed family by bargaining against a series of demons - and outwitting the Devil himself.

Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a care-free, scare-free world of gentle chills.
MUDANG: Two Hearts is a narrative-driven, third-person action adventure that blends tactical stealth, visceral combat, and cinematic storytelling set on a politically volatile Korean peninsula.

Get ready to venture into the world of Farmatic. Prepare to automate the farm work with the help of your trusty bots. Explore and fight your way through the mines. Optimize the transportation of your resources and help the villagers with their tasks. All that alone or with friends!

Live a trucker’s life in the first trucking sim RPG. Explore villages, cities and wilderness in a fully customizable truck. Get on-foot to eat, sleep, and help people along the way. Your goal: to bring back prosperity in your region. Drive, grow, and inspire!

Experience trucking on a new level: by driving and interacting with the world around you. Make your truck unique by customizing it mechanically and visually, inside and outside. Meet people and decide how to approach them. Enjoy the beautiful scenery in different weather conditions. But most of all, see the change you’re making by supporting the economy.

Papa Needs a Headshot is a brutal western-steampunk FPS soaked in kin blood. Rip through flesh and bend the battlefield with your cursed metal arm. Use every bullet wisely to slaughter freaks and abominations on your warpath. Keep enduring only to put a bullet in the skull of the man who made you.
Bloodseed is a game that combines two very distinct but terribly addictive genres; card combat and survival.

Couch Planes is a fast-paced airborne party game where the craftiest pilot wins. Dodge missiles, grab power-ups, and race through hazard-filled maps in various game modes in chaotic local or online matches. Easy to learn, wild to master, always a blast.

Kiipluu is a hardcore stealth adventure set in a brutal Neolithic world.

Every encounter is a tense survival puzzle. Study patrol routes, use tall grass, shadows, sound, and terrain to stay hidden. Set traps, strike from ambush, or slip past unseen. Being discovered can quickly become fatal.

When stealth fails, combat is fast, brutal, and unforgiving. Weapons are primitive. Injuries matter. There are no easy victories.

Along the way, Kiipluu is haunted by dreamlike spirit journeys and visions of his father, a legendary hunter whose shadow looms over every choice. Your decisions shape who survives, who is lost, and what kind of person Kiipluu becomes.

This is a story of fear, survival, and growing up in a world that wants you dead.

Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

Find your lost voices in a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend, via online cross-platform or couch co-op, explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands — where everything you see is crafted by hand.
A push-your-luck roguelike deckbuilder. Set in a corporate backrooms. Played against a creepy puppet.

Son of Thanjai is a cinematic action-adventure epic set in the culturally rich 11th-century South India. As a Chola king burdened by legacy, you must embark on a personal journey that blurs the line between duty and destiny. Will you rise as a legend–or be forgotten?

At Fate’s End is an action-adventure game where you fight the ones you love and your skill tree is your family tree. Explore a lush fantasy world, defeat the foul creatures of the realm, and face your estranged siblings in intense, emotional duels to decide your family’s fate.

Vanran is a dark fantasy action RPG where a human slave in the Demon Realm wields a sealed blade and rises in rebellion. Defeat your enemies, claim their powers, grow stronger, and escape. Seek salvation—or choose vengeance.
Bermuda Triangle is a vertically scrolling shooter released in arcades by SNK in 1987. The player controls a fighter jet and shoots enemies, collects power-ups, and defeats bosses to advance levels.
An alien world for the taking. Explore, survive and make your fortune if you dare. Icarus is a multiplayer co-operative survival game with persistent metagame progression.
Test your skills and guide the ball into the hole across 15 levels of increasing difficulty!

Based on the extraordinary true story of history's first African samurai, embark on an epic journey in feudal Japan. From slave to legendary warrior, live the incredible tale of Yasuke as he masters the way of the samurai and shapes Japan's destiny.
Inspired by the classic and fun arcade motorcycle games of the 90s. With low-poly graphics reminiscent of the 32-bit era of console gaming.

Experience your music collection like never before in this intense, music-driven twin-stick shooter.

Each of your songs creates its own unique ebb and flow, fueling your weapons with the power of the beat. Beat Hazard Arcade seamlessly blends the thrill of gaming and love of music, together they become greater than the sum of their parts.

A sci-fi tower defense game. Create futuristic towers of various types to destroy hordes of aliens that come in waves. Build up resources to create more towers, repair, upgrade etc. Earn rewards for accomplishing certain tasks.

An fmv experiment. Walk down an alley which is a real video recorded in the north east of England avoiding the plague. Time moves when you walk forward but freezes when you move sideways. Anticipate the movement of the plague to avoid infection.

You have exactly 60 minutes to save humanity from nuclear extinction. There are no second attempts. No manual saves. Explore a collapsing bunker, repair critical systems, and solve puzzles under pressure. Succeed or watch the world end.

Flockout is a chaotic 4-player local party game where you play as furious, fluffy sheep in wild mini-games! Chase thieves, slam goals in sheep soccer, or race across wobbly obstacle courses at wool-warping speed. With every match, chaos, laughter, and revenge pile up — making it the perfect couch-party showdown for friends, families, and frenemies alike.

Such A Guy is a first-person narrative game that blends live-action interactive storytelling with light management gameplay. You play as Zane Zheng, a young man who leaves his city job in search of meaning and, together with two close friends, renovates a lakeside guesthouse by the sea. Featuring cinematic-grade filming, real actors, and on-location shooting, the game offers a deeply immersive experience. It combines branching narratives, relationship development, and exploration to create a lifelike yet open-ended interactive journey.

With nearly 1,000 minutes of 4K HD footage at its core, the game incorporates a relationship system and branching events. Players face hundreds of decision points, each influencing the characters' fates and the progression of the story. Over 20 different endings are available, along with side mini-games, hidden surprises, memorable scenes, and an achievement system to encourage exploration and replayability.

Munch Mobile is an action game released by SNK in 1983. Pilot a mysterious car with arms, picking up fuel and food along the way. The goal is to make it home before your fuel runs out. Place trash left from your food into bins to earn big points! Show consideration in public spaces and enjoy a fun drive!
A co-op adventure about driving your Recreational Vehicle home.

Wake up with amnesia in Tokyo, caught between the Yakuza and police. Romance 8 unique beauties: cop, ninja, boss, izakaya owner, heiress, college girl, teacher, model. Uncover your true identity—host, agent, assassin, or crime lord? Shape your destiny and find true love.

Cyber Lab is a challenging 2D platformer with 30 levels set in a futuristic laboratory full of traps and deadly hazards.
The player controls a small robot through a series of precision experiments where every wrong move could be the last.

Inspired by horror and B-movies from the '80s, Everdark takes us to a city infested with vampires. Armed with stakes, garlic, crosses, holy water, and an arsenal of firearms and melee weapons, we'll fight our way through this shooter that blends classic survival horror with an oppressive atmosphere.

Baseball Dreams VR is a true-to-life baseball simulator.
Enjoy realistic games in immersive VR from a first-person view.
Customize your settings for a more casual gameplay experience.
Ultimate Theater Simulator is a first-person cinema management game where you screen movies, serve snacks, hire staff, handle chaos, and grow your dream theater from the ground up.

In shadowed realms where plague winds howl and moan,
Plague Hunters calls, a rogue-like throne,
Turn-based tales in dark fantasy's grip,
Where survivors and hunters join your fateful trip.

Each run a riddle, randomized anew,
Levels rise like ghosts from the misty blue,
Gather your party 'midst the cursed decay,
In a world devoured by plague's grim sway.

With art like fairytales twisted and torn,
Beautiful darkness where nightmares are born,
Battle grotesque foes, bosses foul and vast,
Equip potent perks to endure the blast.

Shrines whisper secrets, a gamble profound,
Luck's fleeting kiss or a curse tightly bound—
Venture forth, hunter, in this plague-wrought dream,
Where victory's edge cuts on fortune's sharp gleam.

Directed by Luc Bernard.

Monster House Racing invites you to rev your engines and speed through the haunted corridors of the Grindstone Manor in this exhilarating kart racing game. Embrace the Halloween spirit as you compete against friends and AI opponents in thrilling races across ghostly tracks filled with supernatural challenges and spooky surprises. Whether you're a seasoned racer or new to the track, Monster House Racing offers a heart-pounding experience perfect for any fan of high-speed action and haunted thrills.

Set in a reimagined Netherlands in 2027, discover a new era of trucking where AI dispatchers work alongside human drivers and the industry is thriving. Join Lucas and Felix as they face new challenges, forge alliances, and adapt to an evolving industry in this next chapter of the Truck Driver series.
Sharpen your focus and put both sides of your brain to the ultimate test in Mind Twist - a fast-paced mental workout designed to confuse, challenge, and train your mind.

Desert War: Military Combat Shooter throws you into the chaos of a war-torn desert city. As an elite soldier, you’ll battle through explosive missions, adapt to shifting combat zones, and outsmart enemies that react to your every move.
A two-player co-op puzzle game with 30 challenging levels. Work together, solve puzzles, and practice deep breathing as your partner "figures it out."

Dive into the futuristic battle of the skies! In Cazzarion: Jetpack Fighter, you pilot a highly advanced jetpack-powered combat robot and engage in high-speed aerial duels against enemy machines. With lightning-fast maneuvers, tactical skill, and precise laser weapons, you fight for supremacy in the skies. Every battle is an explosive showdown of speed, strategy, and firepower. Are you ready to rule the skies?
Survive an apocalyptic wasteland in this open-world apocalyptic car combat game inspired by Mad Max.
A forgotten world awakens — where nature and machine have become one. Step into the boots of an elite soldier sent to reclaim a planet consumed by biomechanical life.

You are blackmailed in Hacked: The Streamer. Investigate clues, make impactful decisions, and shape your story to uncover the culprit is in this thrilling interactive movie. The fate of PinkyPie, a fan-favorite streamer, is in your hands.

Tales of Morphos is a psychological horror/adventure game in which you play as a man who has recently been discharged from a psychiatric hospital after losing his memory.

Upon returning home, your wife, a research scientist, out of compassion and a desire to keep an eye on you, arranges for you to join her team. Your workplace turns out to be a gloomy and mysterious underground complex where experiments with anomalous phenomena are conducted.

At first, everything seems like an attempt to return to normal life, but soon strange things begin to happen underground.

Roller coaster design puzzle meets physics sandbox. In a series of increasingly challenging levels your task is to get creative and build all kinds of crazy coasters. Don't get too crazy, though, or physics will turn your coaster into a rocket.

Me? A lookbook shoot?! New hire Kim Jiwoo joins YouTube studio Lazaworks and gets thrown into photographing top youtubers and his own bosses on day one. Under the bright lights, stolen glances turn into secret favors and forbidden romances. The more you shoot, the more hearts stolen.

The most absurd Souls-like parody ever! You’re a blacksmith with bean-powered dragon abilities, taking on evil corporations with maximum gasitude! Fart-dash, demolish bosses, and break the fourth wall in this hilarious action RPG. Smell the legend!

Step into the shoes of a true TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER, a captivating game that takes you across the endless highways of the United States. Whether you're passionate about trucks or simply looking for a realistic driving experience, this simulator offers the chance to explore major cities, deliver various cargo, and live the life on the open road.

TRUCK SIMULATOR US DRIVER is more than just a game – it’s a virtual journey through the heart of America, filled with challenges, strategic decisions, and relaxing moments on the road. Whether you're a simulation fan or just seeking a unique adventure, this title offers an authentic and engaging experience. Start your engine and conquer the roads of the United States!
Lokko is a bouncy, action-packed 3D platformer where YOU create the adventure! In Lokko, players race to deliver hot pizzas around the globe while battling the sinister Goobol fast-food corporation.

From the creators of Apex Legends and Titanfall, comes Highguard: a PvP raid shooter where players will ride, fight, and raid as Wardens, arcane gunslingers sent to fight for control of a mythical continent.

Ready to become a mad scientist? Synthesize, evolve, and command an army of unique creatures in your own lab. Manage your laboratory, master genetic essences, and dominate the battle arena in this deep creature collection simulator!

Brew your own beer from scratch! Take on the role of a brewmaster, learn brewing techniques, create unique recipes, and grow your craft brewery into a full-scale factory. Expand your brewery from mashing and fermenting to bottling and selling - every decision shapes your beer empire

Begin your park ranger journey in Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator. Maintain trails, assist visitors, check permits and respond to emergencies. Explore diverse biomes and observe varied animal behaviors across a wide range of species.

The spirits of a remote volcanic island have lived in balance for generations, until William Von Pingleton III arrives with a mining army and a plan to turn them into fuel for his machines. When his first attack knocks the island’s shaman, Ila, off her feet, the spirits answer with a gift: the power to command the elements themselves.

In Spirit & Steel, you play as Ila, a short but stubborn 70-year-old shaman who hits harder than she looks. Swap between elemental fists, chain melee combos, and weave in dashes and air movement to outplay swarms of mechanical enemies in tight, focused combat encounters. Every arena asks you to use your full toolkit; knock foes back with wind, pull them in with crashing waves, and burn through armored threats with searing fire.

As you fight deeper into the island, lush beaches and sacred temples slowly clash with scaffolding, smokestacks, and churning machinery.

Your journey builds toward a final showdown with Pingleton in his volcanic stronghold, where you’ll put all of your unlocked elements to the test. Defeat him, free the captured spirits, and restore the island’s balance, or watch it disappear under steel.

Clean Up Earth is a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Clean Up Earth is the first original IP from Magic Pockets studio, based in France. Clean Up Earth will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) in Q1 2026, with the console launch dates to be confirmed following the Kickstarter campaign.

Clean Up Earth invites players to restore polluted environments to their natural beauty and unwind, solo or with friends. Using the Terra Cleaner, a futuristic, customisable cleaning tool, they rejuvenate landscapes inspired by the real world, from serene mountain ranges to tropical beaches. As they progress, they unlock new modules and upgrades to take on increasingly complex challenges. The Terra Cleaner can also be used to repair damaged equipment and structures, enabling players to use them to access new zones.

The game supports solo play and cooperative multiplayer, with maps for 2 to 8 players depending on their size, as well as larger maps that accommodate 30+ players.

In this turn-based RPG musical, join Cadence as she recruits an ensemble of musicians on her quest for stardom. Experience turn-based combat like never before, where each battle is a musical performance with evolving combat conditions and genre-bending mashup attacks!

Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is running. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.
A non-VR release of a an arcade brick-breaker.
Trapped on the Moon, two astronauts must work together to escape! Solve clever co-op puzzles, share laughs, and survive a hilarious lunar adventure with your partner.
Single-screen puzzle action with lasers, switches, pits, and a troublesome creature. Solve each level at your own pace, or speedrun your way to a shiny new best time.

You, an ordinary youth, accidentally travel to a parallel Three Kingdoms era. By fate, you encounter famous historical generals and beauties. Faced with emotional and historical choices, will you retire in the mountains with a beauty, or lead generals into battle?

Enter unstable rifts, survive otherworldly creatures, and grab bizarre ingredients to fuel a secret brewery hidden beneath a British pub. Hazard Levels is a 1–4 player physics-driven co-op survival horror where the deeper you go, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

It Reaches is a first person horror game, captured through the lens of a police officer’s body cam. Trapped inside the facilities of an abandoned hospital, find a way to escape the horrors lurking underground. Uncover a dark mystery left behind and don't get caught! They will reach for you…

Storm The Sewers for the glory of the Swamp King! Swing, jump, catapult your friends, and eat eat EAT until you grow into a humongous Megafrog. A co-op extraction puzzle-platformer for up to 8 players. Squad up with your frog friends for a friendslop party in this slapstick physics adventure!

Junkster is a 3D action platformer with an awesome building mechanic. Plucky, little construction bot, UM-13 has crash-landed on a dangerous junkyard planet. Armed only with his trusty robo-wrench, Um must find the parts to repair his ship and recover his lost cargo of precious human artifacts.

Full Stride is a jockey racing game focused on first-person riding and skill-based race control.
Players manage speed, stamina, positioning, and timing while adapting to each horse’s characteristics and the layout of 3D racecourses.

UnGodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

Project DeepWeb: Eternal Nightmare is a desktop-like adventure game about exploration of the Deep Internet, a sequel to Project DeepWeb. Inspired by Internet lore and real netstalking experience, it tells a story of a person who got stuck in the wrong place at the wrong time.

The Show’s over. Time to wake up.

Build and manage your ultimate retro arcade! Buy classic Arcade Machines, Galaxy Pinball, and Gift Claw games, or invest in Cinema 8D, Go-Karts, and Racing Simulators. Manage the economy, hire staff, and repair your machines to keep the tokens rolling in!

Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

Head to the USA and grow your own business with a realistic and relaxing lawn mowing experience! With brand new grass tech and reworked systems based on player feedback to the original, plus licensed equipment from around the world.

From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a narrative adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.
Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

Lost Host is a story-driven adventure puzzle game about a small toy car searching for its missing owner.
When the boy mysteriously disappears, the toy car begins a journey through the house and beyond, exploring dark rooms, hallways, foggy streets, and abandoned places while following clues to uncover what happened.

Players control the toy car as it navigates dangerous environments, solves physics-based puzzles, and interacts with objects to progress. The world is full of hazards for a tiny toy car - heights, fire, water - as well as enemies such as dogs, robotic vacuums, and hostile toy creatures.

The game combines atmospheric exploration, light horror elements, and emotional storytelling, creating a family-friendly adventure centered on mystery, discovery, and survival in a large, human-sized world.
Manage and expand your own cinema. Upgrade equipment, customize interiors, schedule movies, set ticket prices, hire staff, and handle repairs to create the ultimate movie-watching experience!

Parasite Mutant is a science-fiction horror RPG set in the distant future. Psionic agent Nova was sent on a mission to an abandoned and secluded island city filled with horrifying creatures, not knowing that what happened on the island will completely change her fate.

Reputation is paramount; strategy is key, and all-out speed can make or break everything. Welcome to Metro Rivals—a genre-defying subway simcade game where you battle Track Titans in solo play or clash with friends in fierce PvP.

Lived through the Plague, did you? Now try surviving till morning on an island erased from the maps. Gather, build, and fight to keep your light alive in Brightfall - a co-op open world survival-craft roguelite where the darkness wants to swallow you whole.
Cast your line into calm waters and feel the quiet pull beneath the surface. Each cast brings rewards, but some things you reel in were never meant to be found.

Seina: A Tale of Spirits is a cozy fantasy adventure about Mika, a young girl searching for her lost cat, Seina. Her journey leads her into a peaceful, hand-painted world filled with cute animal spirits, ancient shrines, and quiet magic.

Humanity Echo is a tactical turn-based RPG set in the rusted harbour slums of Odesa, 2044.

You play as an Engineer - not a soldier - using sabotage, environmental manipulation, and raw intellect to outsmart a corporate machine. In this high-tech, low-life world, every explosion carries physical weight and every shot leaves a unique acoustic imprint.

ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.
Lead a cult and prepare for the end of the world in Join Us, the upcoming co-op, open-world survival experience. Ride bears, build up your perfect base, and prepare for the apocalypse.

Explore a quintessential British village collecting artefacts and studying local history. Solve a dark mystery that draws in you and your family. Complete quests for villagers who have a habit of losing their treasured possessions. Donate, trade and sell your ‘finds’ to build impressive collections.

Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator taking place in a gritty, cassette-future. Humanity has spread throughout the solar system and started extracting its natural resources.

You play as the security officer aboard PALE HORSE - a Galileo Corporation vessel carrying miners set for Ganymede, Jupiter's biggest moon. It’s your job to assess the intentions of approaching ships, decide their fate, and keep your crew alive. The company is watching.

Chronoscript: The Endless End is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its endacross 2D pages and a 3D manor.

You are a handyman renovating a massive research facility abandoned after a mysterious incident. The Lift is an eerie first-person simulator with satisfying house-flipping gameplay, a mind-bending story, and a highly interactive world inspired by Soviet sci-fi and the SCP Foundation.

Help Zozo find his way home in this cartoon-inspired Metroidvania platformer. Pillow-fight sentient pastries, train under an octopus master, and brave a cybernetic jungle as you explore the vibrant landscapes of Zozo's dreams.
Prospice blends tense driving and atmospheric horror as you haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain hungers and every road bears the scars of the past.

An open-world action Korean mythology RPG. Players will explore a detailed and in-depth world across a single-player adventure inspired by ancient folklore that reimagines Korea’s traditional Tal masks. Engage with an array of threats from massive monsters to formidable swordsmen, making use of enemy weak points, counterattacks, unique abilities, and more.

UN:Me is an adventure game where you guide a girl harboring multiple souls within her body through an unsettling mental labyrinth, engaging in dialogue with each soul while making the harrowing choice of which to keep and which to erase in your escape attempt.
Run fast and free as a sheepdog in a beautiful but troubled world. Herd masses of lost sheep to a secret refuge. Discover a mysterious calamity that only you can stop.

Welcome to Port Desire, a city that doesn't belong to anyone, but where everyone wants a piece. You’re Grey Harker, an ex-military attempting to live a quiet life after near fatal injuries in the field. All you want now is peace - but in a city of no laws, what you want isn’t always what you get.

A sci-fi mystery set on the repurposed moon hotel Samsara. Uncover cryptic experiments, face unsettling encounters, and piece together a mind-bending narrative. The deeper you go, the more the truth unravels as you confront the ultimate question: What is reality?

Off the Grid: Bad Dream (working title: Project Escher) is a first- and third-person psychological thriller and mystery adventure developed by Rare Castle. The game follows a man who survives a fatal car crash and begins experiencing surreal dreams connected to a plane of existence beyond space and time.

Gameplay alternates between the protagonist’s grounded real-world life and an otherworldly dream realm, where consciousness exists as light or energy within mechanical vessels. Players explore non-Euclidean environments, solve puzzles, engage in limited combat, and make narrative choices emphasizing introspection, moral decision-making, and emotional healing over traditional horror.

Featuring cinematic storytelling, dialogue-driven encounters, and visually distinct worlds inspired by impossible geometry and classical art, Off the Grid: Bad Dream blends mystery, philosophy, and emotional depth into a story-driven experience focused on self-discovery and healing rather than fear.
Panzer Knights is a single-player action game about tanks. Players will cross from Western to Eastern Europe as a German Tank Commander, and experience the battles from 1939-1943.

Necrophosis is a first-person horror adventure that immerses you in a nightmarish-hellish world filled with bizarre forms and somber visuals. Explore eerie-surreal landscapes and unravel mysteries in this atmospheric journey through the macabre.

Experience the Freedom of Flight

Take control of your own high-performance drone and explore a world built for pure flight. Drone Simulator brings you the authentic thrill of piloting realistic quadcopters — from smooth camera drones to agile FPV racers — each offering a unique feel and personality in the air.

The world has fallen to a ruthless artificial intelligence determined to erase mankind. Cities lie in ruins, the skies swarm with machines, and the future hangs by a thread.

You are John Veyron, a soldier reborn through brutal experiments, stripped of his past but armed with unbreakable resolve. With only steel and firepower at his side, John must march through hostile strongholds, confront merciless AI champions, and take the fight straight to the heart of the machine.

‘Twas the night before Christmas—and something slimy is stirring.

You’re on the naughty list, and something green is coming for you. Something pickled! Run, hide, and survive the brined wrath of the Christmas Pickle—a festive slasher nightmare soaked in blood, and vinegar.

Deck the halls… with screams. Because this Christmas Dill be your last!

Step into the arena where legends are forged in this breathtaking realistic gladiatorial RPG! Powered by Unreal Engine 5's cutting-edge technology, experience brutal combat and epic glory in stunning photorealistic detail.
From slave to legend, forge your path through treacherous gladiatorial schools and blood-soaked arenas. Master diverse fighting styles, earn the crowd's favor, and rise to become the most celebrated warrior in the empire.

“Paws & Clean: Japan” takes you inside a traditional Japanese school where your loyal pet companion helps you tidy classrooms, hallways, and courtyard areas. Sweep floors, collect trash, polish surfaces, and bring order to every corner. Easy controls, calm atmosphere, and satisfying cleaning tasks make this a relaxing experience for all ages.

In Fire Jump, you will guide a brave girl across a series of platforms suspended above a sea of burning lava. Every jump is a challenge: some platforms are stable, while others sway or move. A moment of distraction could mean the end! Carefully calculate timing and distance, stay focused, and find the best path to reach the finish line.
Experience the ultimate horse care and riding adventure! Discover the joy of building a special bond with your own horse through daily care, training, and exciting riding challenges.

Arcade Room Simulator – Build, Manage, and Play!

Step into the world of neon lights and nostalgic gaming in Arcade Room Simulator, a first-person immersive simulation where you become the owner of your very own arcade! Start with a small space, purchase and upgrade machines, and create a thriving entertainment hub filled with classic and modern arcade games.

One strike decides your fate:

Enter a world of silhouettes and steel in Fatal Slash, a minimalist 2D dueling game of precision, timing, and tension. Every encounter is a deadly test where a single cut can end the fight. There are no long combos or super moves - only patience, skill, and the courage to strike first.
Racecar Crashers is a high-octane, couch multiplayer, competitive racing experience, where up to 4 friends (or enemies) compete to be the last car standing.

Claim vengeance as a vampire forged in darkness.

On your wedding day, your priest murdered you, stole your bride, and unleashed plague and demons upon your land. Ten years later, you rise from the underworld as a powerful vampire — driven by rage, cursed by immortality, and sworn to reclaim everything taken from you.
Classic survival horror focused on puzzle-solving, exploration, and strategy.

The world we once knew no longer exists, the infected are everywhere. Will you be able to keep your sanity? Among hidden clues and scarce resources, you must find a way to escape. Fight for your survival.
In this horror, comedy, and puzzle game, you will play as a demon summoned by an old woman to fix her television, sending you on an adventure beyond all reason.

Test your reflexes and precision by guiding a ball down a series of suspended steps. The goal is simple: reach the end of the level without falling or losing control. Each level introduces new challenges, with increasingly complex steps, narrower paths, obstacles, and routes that require perfect timing and skill.

In an abandoned hospital long forgotten by time, the hallways are littered with shattered glass. Dim, flickering lights cast distorted shadows across peeling walls, while pieces of the ceiling occasionally break loose and crash to the floor, echoing through the empty corridors. Everything around Sophie feels strangely unreal — as if the hospital exists somewhere between memory and nightmare, more atmospheric than truly physical.

You’ve become lost in an endless maze of yellow rooms, with stained carpet underfoot and the hum of fluorescent lights buzzing overhead. This place is The Backrooms. There are no windows. No doors. No escape… only the emptiness and something watching you.

Shout — and Cast!
In Mage Wars, you control magic with your voice. Your real voice.

Want to blow up your enemies? Just say “Fireball!”
Want to disappear? Say “Invisible!” — and vanish into the shadows.

Yes, your voice is your weapon. Experience magic like never before!
